invariants: Destructive integration is never the default.
Unexecuted controls are not certified as passes.
procedure: Freeze and hash the staged source and target.
Scan transients, local paths, likely secrets, duplicates, and overlaps.
Produce dry-run dispositions that protect stronger artifacts.
Run syntax, schema, functional, failure, rollback, and archive tests.
Publish deterministic archive, manifest, limitations, and revocation triggers.

summary: Find exact, partial, semantic, runtime, schema, test, and ownership overlap and emit dry-run reuse, extend, compose, merge, alias, migrate, quarantine, or reject dispositions.
